text: The drag receiver builds an AttachmentInfo for each URL and awaits each import before refreshing the destination. The importer fetches and normalizes data, writes a temp file and awaits a copy promise settled by onStopCopy. Refresh has a separate IMAP URL-listener completion. The original only removes the file after success; later try/finally cleanup belongs to the Copy To phase. The synthetic test replaces the importer, so it supports routing and canned-message assertions rather than the production fetch/cleanup path.
title: Attached-message drops await the copy callback before refreshing the folder
